method.capDefinition: an entry of `attempts` whose `error` matches interrupt|timed\s?out|timeout|terminat|deadline (case-insensitive); SQLite reports `interrupted` when the 60 s progress-handler deadline fires, Neo4j runs with a 60 s transaction timeout (run_chain_eval.py)
method.shapeDefinition: texts are grouped when they are identical after whitespace normalisation with every string literal replaced by a slot; a slot whose value varies inside a group must come from the item's anchor or question, otherwise the group is split on it
method.planOnly: SQL: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on the working group's SQLite file opened with mode=ro; Cypher: EXPLAIN in a read-access session; neither executes the query

method.loopInBlock: position of a SCAN or SEARCH step among the SCAN/SEARCH steps that share its parent in the EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN tree (1 is the outermost loop of that join block)
